info.title: Ophiolite public API
info.description: One public API for every project operation. Three credential kinds reach it: the browser session (opaque HttpOnly cookie plus the X-CSRF-Token proof and, on non-GET requests, the exact Origin), a project-scoped delegate lasting at most five minutes (Bearer oph_api_..., parent session and current native permissions remain mandatory), and a browser-approved provider grant (Bearer provider token plus X-Ophiolite-Application-Grant; capability 1: the scientific read resources and the applications route within its read/write scopes; capability 3 adds reading wells, wellbores and lineage and the LAS upload routes). A request that carries an Authorization header is a machine request and is refused with MACHINE_AUTH_REQUIRED when a cookie or Origin travels with it. Scope and capability are ceilings; every operation runs the same native permission checks whoever calls it. Not a stable SDK or unattended service-account contract.

x-ophiolite-deprecated-aliases.condition: Removed after every Integration caller listed in docs/api-routes.md has moved to the public routes; not before E5.

lists 'package' (the package manifest), 'interpretation' (recipe, decisions, evidence) and one

canonical JSON of {schema, asset_id, revision, artifact, representations (sorted by id),
lineage (the sorted commitments)}; context and interpretation are inside the representation
bytes it names. Access decisions, labels, heads and times are not part of it.

get.description: Public description; carries no project data. Lists every schema, profile and document with display names, versions and lifecycle badges. Reachable with or without browser cookies.

Serves the document at a registry-relative path only if the index lists it (schemas[].path, profiles[].path, documents[].path); any other path is 404 not-found and no filesystem lookup happens. Schema ids contain "/", so documents are addressed by path; the index maps ids to paths.

200.description: The document bytes with their media type

schema.description: A listed registry document; its shape is the schema the index names for it

404.description: Path not listed by the index

bearer.description: A project delegate (oph_api_...), an agent (oph_agent_...; changes need X-Ophiolite-Plan naming an approved plan) or a provider access token with X-Ophiolite-Application-Grant; never with a browser cookie or Origin

session.name: ab_session
session.description: The browser session; X-CSRF-Token must equal the session proof on every request, and non-GET requests carry the exact Origin

BundleOrigin.description:
E18: where an imported file came from — provenance, not authority. The imported asset is a new
asset of the person who imports it; this only names the portable bundle and what it exported.
BundleOrigin.title: BundleOrigin

ChangeEvent.description: E28: one event as it leaves the gateway; re-read the named subject for its state.
ChangeEvent.title: ChangeEvent

ContractsRegistry.title: ContractsRegistry
ContractsRegistry.description: The registry index. Ids follow id_grammar; versions are semver of the document; paths are registry-relative and never leave contracts/.

InventoryItem.description: E28: one logical asset at its current head; `authority` says where it lives (managed, native, retained).
InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem

PackageMember.description: E23a: one file of a source package; the request body is the members' bytes in the listed order.
PackageMember.title: PackageMember

ProjectEntry.description:
A project the calling credential may reach. organization_id is null when the project is not bound to
an organisation the reader belongs to (for example a project shared with the reader directly).
ProjectEntry.title: ProjectEntry

RecipeReference.description: E23a: a recipe is a project-scoped asset at an exact revision.
RecipeReference.title: RecipeReference
